Giardinetti-Tor Vergata — Rome, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Giardinetti-Tor Vergata is a mixed residential and institutional zone anchored by the University of Rome Tor Vergata campus. Local press reported a homicide in the area, a young man killed on Via Torresini in Giardinetti, with press noting that fear kept witnesses from coming forward during the investigation. Police have also carried out narcotics raids with multiple arrests across Tor Vergata, Romanina and Giardinetti, and a professor was robbed at knifepoint on the university campus. Given the documented homicide and recurring drug enforcement operations, this is one of the more concerning zones in the municipio at night; daytime university and residential life is largely normal but not risk-free.
